document.subject: Additional testing of MSC of X6D5RN
document.reasonsForChange: Due to client's request (pers. comm. by FTE, 28 Jan. 98)
document.changeDescription:
In addition, the MSC of the test cigarette X6D5RN will be prepared and assayed.
X6D5RN (synonym previously "ATT"): 168,000 cigarettes received on 12 Mar. 95, INBIFO code K 186, base-web sheet of "CDL".
The MSC will be dosed at 0.05, 0.10, 0.20, and 0.40 mg dry condensate/plate. The controls for the assay will be taken from the parallel running study P-/3280.
document.controls: The controls for the assay will be taken from the parallel running study P-/3280
document.consequencesAndMeasures: Information of teams AC and IT
